sentences: An average-distortion embedding controls aggregate squared distances while remaining nonexpansive for every pair.
The source considers the square-root metric associated with a finite-dimensional normed space.
An existence theorem supplies a Hilbert-space embedding with favorable dependence on dimension, but its duality proof does not provide an explicit map.
The task is to construct and evaluate an embedding efficiently from the supplied point set.
This would turn a structural geometric theorem into an algorithmic primitive for proximity search and related computations.
